values.value: Before you start, one thing about how we will read your answers. We have a mapping model and a gap catalogue for this move, and an operator runs the extraction rather than a live connector. Estate figures are illustrative until the extract is taken; the gaps we name in your readout are not — they are structural properties of Journey Builder and will be true of your estate whatever its size.
